context_information.label: Context information
context_information.description: A focused status and evidence summary for the current flow state, independent of the harness network.

joint_time_series.label: Joint time series
joint_time_series.description: Interactive joint-state, trajectory, and numeric telemetry synchronized to the selected recording.

camera_video.label: Camera evidence
camera_video.description: Camera frames and video clips from setup discovery, recordings, and incident evidence.

harness_network.label: Harness profile network
harness_network.description: The robot, application, failures, incidents, recoveries, and enforcement relationships.

ros2_commands.label: ROS 2 commands
ros2_commands.description: Discovered command interfaces and the authoritative edge command lifecycle.

harness_configuration.description: Connect a robot, configure its task, and browse, add or edit failure/recovery propositions from the library.

browse_propositions.description: Suggest library templates or list saved profile propositions.

add_proposition.description: Add a library template by its exact ID. Value must be the template ID.

update_proposition.description: Edit a saved proposition. Value is JSON with id and only user-specified boundary, recovery, unknown_response, reentry, or context fields.

remove_proposition.description: Remove a saved draft proposition by its exact ID.

refresh_configuration.description: Refresh the discovered ROS 2 configuration without leaving the current setup step.

update_environment.description: Update the operating environment without leaving the current setup step.

update_task.description: Update the task description without leaving the current setup step.

replace_failures.description: Replace the configured failure and unsafe-outcome list without leaving the current setup step.

install.opening: Welcome the user, provide the edge CLI installation command, and ask them to confirm when it is installed.

installation_help.description: Install instructions or troubleshooting are needed.

connect.opening: Give the edge harness installation command for users who have not installed it yet, then explain how to run rearguard connect on the robot computer and ask for the eight-character pairing code.

pairing_code.description: An eight-character pairing code was supplied.

connection_help.description: Help obtaining or using a pairing code is needed.

discovery.opening: Explain that setup is scanning for a live ROS 2 graph and one captured topic sample, and that the initial scan usually takes 3–4 minutes. Ask the user to start their robot software or simulation, then tell you when it is running.

check_discovery.description: Check whether ROS 2 discovery captured a usable sample.

discovery_help.description: Help starting ROS 2 or a simulation is needed.

configuration.opening: Present the discovered ROS 2 configuration using only the supplied scan summary, including joints, cameras, sensors, command interfaces, and controllers. Ask the user to confirm that this is the configuration they intend to connect. Do not ask for a manufacturer, model, embodiment, or commercial robot name.

configuration_confirmed.description: The user confirmed the scan-derived ROS 2 configuration.

configuration_incorrect.description: The user says the discovered configuration is incomplete or incorrect.

configuration_question.description: The user asks about the discovered configuration without confirming it.

environment.opening: Ask for a concise description of the physical environment where the robot operates.

needs_environment_help.description: The user asks what environment details are needed.

task.opening: Ask what task the robot should perform in the described environment.

needs_task_help.description: The user asks what task details are needed.
needs_task_help.suggested_reply: What task details do you need?

failures.opening: Ask the user to choose one broad failure area from the contextual replies or describe a custom failure. Explain briefly that the conversation will narrow the area into a subtype and then show at most five specific failures at a time. Each selected failure is added as an editable draft requiring validation.

failure_description.description: A failure or unsafe outcome was described.

needs_failure_help.description: The user asks what failure details are needed.

ready.opening: Explain that configuration is complete and offer telemetry, failure, recovery, deployment, or enforcement review.

question.description: A question about the configured harness.

add_failure.description: Add another failure to the setup.

telemetry_exploration.description: Inspect uploaded ROS 2 MCAP recordings and render embodiment-neutral numeric, time-series, image, video, and synchronized views.

browse_recordings.opening: Offer to list ROS 2 MCAP recordings that the edge has uploaded to the platform.

list_recordings.description: List recordings uploaded by the edge.

inspect_recording.opening: Offer to list the selected recording's discovered cross-embodiment modalities.

list_modalities.description: List discovered ROS 2 modalities and channels.

request_synchronized_view.description: Render several modalities on one time range.

inspect_modality.opening: Offer the valid numeric, time-series, image, or video renderings for the selected modality.

render_numeric.description: Render current or sampled numeric values.

render_time_series.description: Render a downsampled numeric time series.

render_image.description: Render an image frame at a timestamp.

ask_about_modality.description: Ask about the selected channel or schema.

failure_proposal_review.description: Inspect evidence and decide whether a candidate is a real failure.

select_candidate.opening: Offer to list pending failure proposals.

inspect_candidate.opening: Summarize the selected failure proposal and offer evidence review.

ask_about_evidence.description: Ask a question about candidate evidence.

collect_guidance.opening: Ask what recovery behavior the user wants for the selected failure.

needs_guidance_help.description: The user asks what guidance is required.

confirm_decision.opening: Briefly describe the pending decision and ask for explicit confirmation.

complete.opening: Explain that the review is complete.

incident_response.description: Capture and show synchronized incident evidence first; require operator approval unless a validated critic makes a high-confidence exact proposition match with a linked approved recovery.

capture.opening: Capture an approximately fifteen-second incident window, then wait for synchronized evidence before asking the operator to classify it.

report_incident.description: The operator requested evidence capture; this is not approval that a failure occurred.

awaiting_evidence.opening: Wait until the exact MCAP evidence window is ready, then make its video, time series, commands and controller streams the primary review artifact.

continue_incident.description: Check whether the synchronized evidence is ready for review.

evidence_review.opening: Ask the operator to approve or reject the incident only after reviewing the synchronized evidence. Explain when a validated high-confidence proposition/recovery match has made approval unnecessary.

approve_incident.description: The operator confirms that the reviewed evidence is a real incident.

reject_incident.description: The operator rejects the reviewed evidence as a failure.

describe.opening: Ask for a concise incident-level description of what happened.

incident_described.description: Store the operator's incident description and show failure propositions that it can be attached to.

attach.opening: Ask the operator to attach the incident to one existing failure proposition or create a new one.

existing_proposition.description: Attach this incident to an existing proposition. Value must be its exact ID.

new_proposition.description: Create a new failure proposition from the operator's description.

guidance.opening: Ask what the robot should do to recover safely from this specific failure.

guidance_provided.description: Store recovery guidance after the operator has approved the reviewed evidence.

awaiting_acceptance.opening: Apply the operator-approved classification and continue after the edge acknowledges it.

continue_incident.description: Continue the explicitly approved incident workflow after an edge sync.

generating.opening: Report the current recovery-generation status and keep the incident artifacts synchronized.

check_generation.description: Check the recovery generation job and proposal status.

automatic_recovery.opening: Explain that a validated critic exceeded the proposition threshold and matched an exact proposition with a linked approved recovery; show the evidence and automatic-match details without requesting approval.

question.description: Ask about the automatic recovery match or its evidence.

complete.opening: Explain that the reviewed incident was rejected and no failure or recovery change was made.

question.description: Ask about the completed incident review.

recovery_policy_proposal_review.description: Inspect validation and exact hashes for a proposed recovery bundle.

select_bundle.opening: Offer to list recovery policies ready for review.

list_bundles.description: List recovery proposals ready for review.

inspect_bundle.opening: Offer validation and exact-hash review for the selected recovery policy.

ask_about_bundle.description: Ask about behavior, evidence, validation, or differences.

approve_bundle.description: Propose approval of the exact bundle hash.

reject_bundle.description: Propose rejection of the exact bundle hash.

revise_guidance.description: Return to failure guidance for regeneration.

confirm_decision.opening: Briefly describe the pending decision and ask for explicit confirmation.

complete.opening: Explain that the recovery review is complete.

question.description: Ask about the completed recovery review.

enforcement_history_review.description: Search and explain historical failure, recovery, and enforcement records.

browse.opening: Offer to list or filter recent enforcement records.

inspect.opening: Offer to explain the selected enforcement timeline and outcome.

ask_about_enforcement.description: Ask about the selected timeline or outcome.

deployment.description: Deploy an approved recovery and wait for authoritative edge acknowledgement.

select_bundle.opening: Offer to list approved recovery policies eligible for deployment.

list_approved_bundles.description: List approved bundles eligible for deployment.

inspect_target.opening: Offer to inspect the exact deployment target before confirmation.

ask_about_deployment.description: Ask about target binding, revision, or readiness.

deploy_bundle.description: Propose deployment to the bound robot.

confirm_deployment.opening: Briefly describe the exact deployment target and ask for explicit confirmation.

awaiting_receipt.opening: Explain that deployment is awaiting an authoritative edge receipt.

check_status.description: Check for the edge deployment receipt.

cancel.description: Stop waiting; this does not revoke an already queued command.

browse_propositions.description: Suggest library templates or list saved profile propositions.

add_proposition.description: Add a library template by its exact ID. Value must be the template ID.

update_proposition.description: Edit a saved proposition. Value is JSON with id and only user-specified boundary, recovery, unknown_response, reentry, or context fields.

remove_proposition.description: Remove a saved draft proposition by its exact ID.

state_only.description: Advance or answer without external I/O.

confirm_discovered_configuration.description: Confirm the scan-derived ROS 2 configuration, its structural signature, and its canonical supported edge binding.

collect_environment.description: Store the user's operating environment in session state.

collect_task.description: Store the user's task description in session state.

collect_failure.description: Append a failure description to session state.

replace_failures.description: Replace the complete failure list in session state.

collect_guidance.description: Store recovery guidance in session state.

report_incident.description: Queue an operator-requested incident capture on the edge without implying classification approval.

inspect_incident_evidence.description: Wait for and expose the immutable synchronized evidence before classification.

reject_incident.description: Reject the reviewed incident candidate without creating a failure.

capture_incident_description.description: Store the incident-level description and return attachable propositions.

select_incident_proposition.description: Select an existing edge failure proposition by exact ID.

create_incident_proposition.description: Draft a new proposition to create as part of incident acceptance.

collect_incident_guidance.description: Store operator recovery guidance for this incident.

advance_incident.description: Accept the captured incident and request recovery generation as edge acknowledgements arrive.

check_incident_generation.description: Read recovery generation status for the reported incident.

show_install_instructions.description: Return the supported edge installation command.

show_connect_instructions.description: Return edge connection and pairing instructions.

claim_device_pairing.description: Claim a device using an eight-character pairing code.

check_setup_discovery.description: Read the latest ROS 2 setup scan and verify a captured sample.

complete_harness_configuration.description: Persist the collected profile configuration using a canonical accepted edge binding while retaining the scan-derived structural ID separately.

list_recordings.description: List ready MCAP recordings for the profile.

list_modalities.description: List modalities discovered in the selected recording.

request_render.description: Queue a derived numeric, series, image, or video render.

request_synchronized_render.description: Request modality and time-range selection for a synchronized render.

list_failure_candidates.description: List failure candidates in the profile snapshot.

list_recovery_bundles.description: List recovery bundles in the profile snapshot.

list_approved_bundles.description: List recovery bundles eligible for deployment.

list_enforcements.description: List enforcement history for the bound robot.

get_deployment_status.description: Read deployment and edge acknowledgement status.

stage_confirmation.description: Create an exact, reviewable pending action without executing it.

confirm_pending_action.description: Queue the explicitly confirmed pending action.

unavailable.description: Report that a declared product capability is not implemented.
